thread:
ian (PM): short thread: pilot customers want clearer pool behavior controls in Console. goal: let tenants pick a preset (FailFast / Queue / Burst) and see live status.

tara (Eng): agree. MLP idea: preset selector + status panel (used%, queued, recent rejects). keep per-route detail opt-in.

oscar (SRE): ops ask: audit log for policy changes, an override toggle for incidents, and alert when queue > 100 for 5m.

mia (Design): will do a compact horizontal card: preset dropdown + color bar + small metrics. copy: "Pool: 41% used · Queue: 12".

leah (Sales): customers want predictable billing language when Burst is enabled. add explicit banner about possible overage charges. CSV export for finance is a plus.

tara (Eng): implementation sketch: policy API PATCH /pools/:id/policy, status GET /pools/:id/status, runtime consults cached policy TTL 30s. safe fallback to FailFast.

ian (PM): acceptance criteria (MLP): 1) preset selection in Console 2) status API + card 3) audit logs for changes 4) runbook for SRE 5) docs/snippets for Sales.

oscar (SRE): pilot plan: read-only status first (2w), manual ops changes for early customers, full self-serve in 6w.

tara (Eng): estimate: 4 dev-weeks core + 2 weeks UI + 1.5 SRE. can try to reuse billing aggregator for usage numbers.

ian (PM): actionables: tara spike reuse of aggregator, mia deliver mocks, oscar draft runbook, leah coordinate pilot customers. I'll create roadmap ticket with MLP scope.

ian (PM): questions? otherwise moving to tickets.
